title: Design System: มิติผี — Ghost Realm

narrative.overview: A native Tkinter shelter-management game with colored Nang Talung figures, a lantern-lit pavilion, dark blue-green surfaces and parchment text. This records implemented conversation-approved direction, not measured mockup reproduction.
keyCharacteristics: Visitor and management tabs on the right

rules.body: Preserve amber for primary decisions, moss for work and coral for danger while retaining colors in clothing, items and landscape.
rules.name: The Color Role Rule

rules.body: Keep names, status, numbers and controls as native text; portrait artwork contains no baked-in interface copy.
rules.name: The Live Text Rule

dos: Use the shared stage camera for people and scenery.
Keep the pavilion roof visible and actors grounded in the yard.
Keep the name มิติผี.
donts: Claim every dialog or English state was visually verified from the three reference captures.
